description: Adds custom prompts to a product's AI-visibility tracking board (the plan's trackedPromptsPerPlan slots on top of the derived prompt set). Tracked prompts are answered by every scheduled visibility run across the configured engines; get the per-prompt citation trend from the dashboard's AI visibility tab. Requires a key with the rescan scope

prompts.description: The questions to ask the AI engines about this product, e.g. "best alternative to <brand> for <use case>" — normalized (trimmed, case-insensitively deduped) before storage

name: add_tracked_prompts
